[title] Survey Results Summary statistics Quantiles and boxplots Python/Colab Outlook Sampling error and coefficient of variation
[body] The sample variance and standard deviation measure the aleatory uncertainty in the data.
[body] Sampling error
[body] Defined as the standard deviation of the sample mean:
[body] sx = sX √n (5)
[body] Measures how well the sample mean x estimates the population mean. Also known as standard error.
[body] Coefficient of variation
[body] Measures dispersion relative to the mean.
[body] δX = sX
[body] x (6)
[body] Prof. Oke (UMass Amherst) CEE 260/MIE 273 M1b: Summarizing Data September 10, 2026 9 / 16

FIGURE: [description of the image, not printed words] The slide has two large rounded rectangular panels with dark blue header bars and light lavender bodies. The upper panel is labelled “Sampling error” and contains the centered fraction formula s_x = s_x/√n, with equation number (5) at the right. The lower panel is labelled “Coefficient of variation” and contains the centered formula δ_x = s_x/x̄, with equation number (6) at the right. novice.takeaway: Sampling error, or standard error, shows how well a sample average estimates the population average, while the coefficient of variation compares spread with the average.
questions: Why do both formulas use s_x differently?
novice.inferred_claim: Use standard error for mean estimates and coefficient of variation for relative spread.

peer.takeaway: Sampling error (standard error) is the standard deviation of the sample mean and decreases with sample size, while the coefficient of variation expresses standard deviation relative to the mean.
peer.inferred_claim: Use standard error for mean-estimate uncertainty and coefficient of variation for relative dispersion.

expert.takeaway: Sampling error (standard error) is presented as the sample standard deviation divided by [?25lthe square root of sample size, while coefficient of variation is standard deviation relative to the sample mean.
expert.inferred_claim: Use standard error for mean-estimation precision and coefficient of variation for relative dispersion.
